description:

Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care environment

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Des Moines, IA. This is a permanent, full-time opportunity for a professional committed to ensuring accurate resident assessments and comprehensive care planning.

Your expertise will ensure compliance with federal and state regulations, contributing significantly to resident care and facility reimbursement.

If you are an RN with a passion for detailed assessment and a commitment to quality care, we encourage you to apply. This role offers a chance to make a lasting impact within a supportive environment.
requirements: Registered Nurse (RN) license preferred
Prior experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of the RAI process and Medicare/Medicaid regulations
Excellent assessment, documentation, and organizational skills

description:
Join a premier medical center in Morristown, NJ, as a Labor & Delivery Registered Nurse for an exciting 13-week contract. This PM shift role offers a competitive hourly rate of $66-$68, providing a fantastic opportunity to deliver exceptional care to mothers and newborns during a pivotal time. You will be an integral part of a dedicated team, ensuring positive outcomes and a supportive environment for families.

In this vital role, you will provide direct patient care, monitor maternal and fetal well-being, assist with deliveries, and offer comprehensive postpartum and newborn care. Your expertise will be crucial in educating patients and their families, collaborating with an interdisciplinary team to uphold the highest standards of care. This contract position is ideal for an experienced L&D RN seeking a dynamic and rewarding short-term engagement.
requirements: Active New Jersey Registered Nurse (RN) license
BLS, ACLS, and NRP certifications
Minimum of 2 years of recent Labor & Delivery experience
Experience with EPIC electronic health record system preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $66-$68 for a 13-week contract.
